The guarantee, defined

What counts as a qualified applicant

A qualified applicant is someone who applies through your post and matches the role’s trade, city area, and shift. In plain terms, all three of these:

  • The tradeTheir background matches the role — the PLC and automation platforms and the experience your post calls for.
  • The Michigan work areaThey are in, or can commute to, the job’s Michigan work area.
  • The shiftThey are available for the shift the post states.

The free-repost guarantee

Fewer than 3 qualified applicants in 30 days = a free 30-day repost — and the repost runs upgraded to Featured, with top placement and a featured spot in the candidate email.

Claim it by replying to any email from us. No forms, no argument. One guarantee repost per post. Two things we ask in return: keep a pay range on your post — roles with pay ranges draw more qualified applicants — and review the people who apply. If you haven’t opened them yet, we’ll walk the list with you before a claim is settled.

Questions

What employers ask us

What exactly counts as a qualified applicant?

Someone who applies through your post and matches the role on all three counts: the trade (the PLC/automation platforms and experience your post calls for), the Michigan work area (in, or able to commute to, the job’s area), and the shift your post states. That definition is the whole guarantee — it is written here, in full, before you pay anything.

What happens if we get fewer than 3 qualified applicants?

Your repost is free — a full 30 days, upgraded to Featured with top placement and a featured spot in the candidate email. Claim it by replying to any email from us; there is no claim form and no argument. We ask only that your post carried a pay range and that you reviewed the applicants who came through — if you haven’t opened them yet, we’ll walk the list with you first.

Are you a staffing agency?

No. We are a job board, not a staffing agency. There are no placement fees, no percentage of salary, and no markup on the hire — applicants apply straight to you and belong to you. The post price is the whole price.

Can I post the same role for two plants?

Yes. Add the second Michigan location right in checkout for $49, or submit a separate post for each plant — whichever is simpler for your team.

Who actually sees my post?

Michigan controls techs: visitors to this board, readers of the weekly roundup email, and job seekers who find your post’s own page through Google job search, where it is eligible to appear thanks to its structured data. Nobody outside the trade and the state is the point — that focus is what you are paying for.

How do I pay? Can we use an invoice or a PO?

Card payment runs through secure Stripe checkout — pick a tier below and continue to checkout. If your accounts-payable process needs an invoice or a purchase order instead, submit the form and say so in your reply to our confirmation email: we’ll invoice your AP department and put the post live on invoice. No card required.
